description: Incidente atendido por Bomberos. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos - UAECOB. Emergencia que atiende el Cuerpo Especial de Bomberos de Bogotá relacionada con incendio, explosión, calamidad conexa y demás situaciones de emergencia que se presenten en el Distrito Capital. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos - UAECOB. Its tags are Bogotá D.C., Gestión del riesgo, Incendios, Incidentes, UAECOB. It offers 23 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
